hooks.name: Page budget guard
hooks.description: When the agent edits the planner, escalation or pager codes, restate Revenant's paging rules and ask for a unit test before it continues.

action.prompt: You just edited the paging engine. Before continuing, confirm: (1) no page fires at an event's start unless the action is to start (focus block or video call); (2) the beeping pages per local day never exceed settings.dailyBudget, and anything cut lands in that day's digest; (3) the engine stays pure, with no Date.now(), randomness or I/O; (4) ACK still cancels every later repeat of that page. Add or update a unit test under tests/unit for any rule you changed, then run `npm test`.
